newsitem.title: UK: Ashquay rights evokes 56.1 pct response.
newsitem.headline: Ashquay rights evokes 56.1 pct response.

text.p: Britain's Ashquay Group Plc said on Friday that it had received valid acceptances and subscriptions in respect of 56.1 percent of its shareholding for its one for six rights issue.
The issue had been priced at 33 pence per share and was meant to raise 1.5 million stg.
Ashquay said it had received valid acceptances for only 565,634 shares and had made conditional firm placements for 1,948,759 shares.
Ashquay had recently failed in a hostile bid for property development firm UK Estates Plc which lapsed after it got valid acceptances in respect to only 45.78 percent of UK Estates's share capital.
